variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port the Camofox Browser server listens on. Railway injects this automatically.

variables.name: CAMOFOX_API_KEY
variables.description: API key for authentication. Auto-generated on deploy. Set to empty string to disable auth (anyone with the URL can use the service).

variables.name: CAMOFOX_ADMIN_KEY
variables.description: Admin key for privileged operations (stats, management). Auto-generated on deploy. Set to empty string to disable admin endpoints.

variables.name: CAMOFOX_PROFILE_DIR
variables.description: Directory for storing browser profiles (cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB). Set to /data/profiles to use a Railway volume for persistence across restarts.

variables.name: MAX_SESSIONS
variables.description: Maximum number of concurrent browser sessions. Each session uses significant memory (500MB+). Reduce if memory-constrained.

variables.name: BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Browser idle timeout in milliseconds (5 minutes). Browsers with no activity are shut down to save resources.

variables.name: CAMOFOX_INTERACTIVE
variables.description: Interactive mode: 'off' (headless only), 'desktop' (always interactive), 'novnc' (VNC via browser), 'auto' (detect based on capabilities).
